The '''CEC shipyards''', best know as the '''Corellian shipyards''', were massive [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Operated by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], the Corellian shipyards were among the most important and renowned starship-building facilities in the galaxy. The Corellian yards were the birthplace of some of the most famous and long-lasting ships in galactic history.

==Description==
The Corellian shipyards were massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-building factories built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Thew were part of a huge net of industrial facilities, the [[Orbital Industrial Zone]], that spread across half of Corellia's orbit.<ref name="SoF" /> The Corellian yards were operated by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="CatCW" /> They manufactured starships and starship pieces.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> The CEC shipyards could produce both civilian and military vessels,<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> from tiny scout pods to massive military [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaughts]].<ref name="TOR-SM">{{TORcite|type=codex|Starship Manufacturing}}</ref> The Corellian yards were considered to be on par with the shipyards over [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

The entirety of the [[Orbital Industrial Zone]], including the shipyards, was overseen by the [[Corellian Port Authority]].<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> Because of their strategic value, the CEC shipyards were patrolled by the [[Corellian Security Force]] and the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]]. They defended the yards from sabotage, industrial espionage, or general vandalism.<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
{{Quote|With Duro a short distance down the Corellian Trade Spine, many Corellians are now bracing themselves for an impending attack from the Confederacy. CorSec forces have been at maximum alert throughout the sector, particularly in the protection of the Corellian Engineering Corporation shipyards.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="Insider75">{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}}</ref>}}
Corellian shipyards were originally built both in orbit and at the surface of the planet Corellia.<ref name="TOR-SM" /> Such planetside facilities included the [[Blastfield Shipyards]]<ref name="TOR-BS">{{TORcite|type=location|Blastfield Shipyards|Corellia}}</ref> and the [[Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR-MCS">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Meridian Complex Shipyard}}</ref> However, centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Corellian government decide to move all Corellia's medium and heavy industries to orbit<ref name="SoF" /> in order to avoid urban overgrowth<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|140|Corellia}}</ref> and prevent an impending ecological disaster.<ref name="SoF" /> This decision allowed Corellia to remain largely rural<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and unpolluted.<ref name="TCSWE" />

The Corellian shipyards provided the bulk of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TORE" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Corellia remained neutral in the war. However, after the Confederacy [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|conquered]] the neighboring world of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], the Corellians prepared themselves for an attack. CorSec forces were put at maximum alert throughout the sector, particularly in the protection of the CEC shipyards.<ref name="Insider75" />

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Corellian shipyards were taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="DB" /> although they remained officially under Corellian control. The Corellian [[Diktat]] was forced to accept to control CEC's starship production according to Imperial directives in order to avoid direct control by the Empire.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Corellian Engineering Corporation then produced [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the [[Corellian Sector Fleet|Imperial sector fleet]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Despite the arrangement concluded between the Empire and the Diktat, squadrons of Imperial starships visited the shipyards on several occasions to protect the Imperial interests, generating protests among Corellian civilians.<ref name="TFUCG" />

Around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Corellian system was defended by 25 Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jaeffis]]. In the six months since the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Aggressor (Executor-class)|''Aggressor'']] and its escort of five Star Destroyers, led by Admiral [[Roek]], were recalled from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] to protect the Corellian shipyards from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="R&R:TJtC">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Corellian shipyards were damaged and made mostly inoperative.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

The Corellian shipyards were [[Operation Roundabout|targeted]] by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Betrayal" />
